scopeLimits: The WUP point is a settlement population centroid, not a parcel identity or city boundary. Nashik-district map digitization and local city-survey offices do not prove the point is covered by the public viewer or that a full vector layer is downloadable. No personal property identifiers, owner, address, tax, or account fields were submitted or saved; no login or CAPTCHA was used.

registryBasis: Maharashtra’s official land-records department lists the Nashik District Superintendent of Land Records and two Nashik city-survey special deputy superintendents responsible for city/town survey matters. The district information page reports original cadastral maps digitized under DILRMP and the department links Mahabhunakasha maps with land records. These establish local survey/map records and a public map portal, not an anonymous full-polygon export at the WUP locator.

Official portal describes Mahabhunakasha as maps integrated with land records and explains that survey-number maps show boundaries, area, and adjacent survey groups.
